tests.procedure: Under strong white light check each received sample container separately on a clean transparent watch glass or glass dish for foreign particles, colour and conformity with the in-house visual specification.
tests.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:30

tests.procedure: Weigh 1 capsule in a stoppered tube; add 25 mL of the solvent, shake vigorously 1 min, hold at 25.0 ± 0.5 °C for 15 min. If not completely dissolved, the capsule is practically insoluble.

details.solvent: not named in the STM (spec sheet: common organic solvents; gelling grades swell in cold water)
details.reference: BP 2024 (SC IV K.) Characters Section in Monographs; In-House Specification

tests.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:31

tests.procedure: Average weight: weigh about 10 capsules individually; average = sum of weights / 10. Limit 62.0 mg ±7.5% (57.35 mg to 66.65 mg).
tests.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:32

tests.procedure: Closed joined filled length: with a calibrated digital caliper measure the capsule shell length (L) of 10 capsules; length (mm) = sum of lengths / 10. Limit 17.7 mm ±0.3 (17.4 to 18 mm).
tests.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:33

tests.procedure: Closure: check the lock of 10 capsules visually.
tests.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:34

tests.procedure: pH: dissolve about 1.0 g capsule in 100 mL water; measure with a calibrated pH meter (BP 2024 Appendix V L).

details.reference: BP 2024 Appendix V L; In-House Specification

tests.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:35

tests.procedure: Brittleness: press on the capsule shell to check brittleness; repeat on 10 capsules. Limit: no brittleness.
tests.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:36

tests.procedure: Disintegration (BP 2024 Appendix XII A): place 5 shells in the tubes of a calibrated disintegration apparatus; record the time of disintegration of each shell (T); time (min) = sum of times / 5. Limit NMT 15 min.

details.reference: BP 2024 Appendix XII A; In-House Specification

tests.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:37

tests.procedure: Ash (sulfated ash, BP 2024 Appendix IX A): weigh an empty crucible ignited at 600-650 °C and cooled in desiccator (W0); weigh 1.0 g into a platinum crucible (W1); moisten with about 1 mL sulfuric acid, heat gently until thoroughly charred; after cooling moisten with sulfuric acid and heat until white fumes cease; ignite in a calibrated muffle at 600-650 °C, cool in desiccator and weigh (W2); repeat to constant weight. % ash = (W2 - W0) / (W1 - W0) x 100. Limit NMT 7.0%.

details.reference: BP 2024 Appendix IX A; In-House Specification

tests.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:38

tests.procedure: Loss on drying (BP 2024 Appendix IX D): weigh an empty weighing bottle previously dried at 105 °C and cooled (W0); weigh accurately 1.000 g (W1); dry in a calibrated oven at 105 °C for 2 h, cool, weigh (W2); repeat to constant weight. % = (W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0) x 100. Limit 13.0 to 16.0%.

details.drying: calibrated oven 105 °C, 2 h, then to constant weight
details.reference: BP 2024 Appendix IX D; In-House Specification

tests.procedure: Microbial enumeration (USP <2021>), aseptic technique under LAF: suspend 167 capsules (about 10 g) in 100 mL soybean casein digest broth with 4% polysorbate 20 (SCDB'), warm in water bath at max 45 °C for not more than 45 min until dissolved; within 1 h pipette 1 mL of the dilution into each of four plates (two with SCDA for TAMC, two with SDA for TYMC). Incubate SCDA plates 24-72 h at 30-35 °C. Count; total CFU/g = (sum of colonies on the two plates / 2) x DF (10); if no colonies, report less than 10 CFU/g.

details.broth: SCDB' (soybean casein digest broth with 4% polysorbate 20), 100 mL
details.limit: Not more than 10^3 CFU/gm (STM prints 103, superscript lost; spec sheet NMT 103, loaded as 1000)

tests.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:40

tests.procedure: Microbial enumeration (USP <2021>): as for TAMC, the two SDA plates are incubated 5-7 days at 20-25 °C; total yeasts and molds CFU/g = (sum of colonies on the two plates / 2) x DF (10).

details.limit: Not more than 10^2 CFU/gm (STM prints 102, superscript lost; spec sheet NMT 102, loaded as 100)

tests.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:40

tests.procedure: Specified microorganism E. coli (USP <2022>): incubate SCDB' 30-35 °C 24-48 h; transfer 1 mL to 10 mL MacConkey broth, incubate 42-44 °C 24-48 h; subculture both broths on MacConkey agar, 30-35 °C 18-24 h; brick red colonies indicate possible E. coli; confirm by Gram stain (gram-negative short rods), EMB (dark centred colonies with or without metallic sheen) and TBX (blue or green colonies, 42-44 °C 18-72 h); if possible confirm with an identification system (report if probability above 70%). Limit absent in 10 g.
tests.source: Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two__Green Empty Hard Gelatin Capsule Size Two -SM.txt:41

tests.procedure: Specified microorganism Salmonella spp. (USP <2022>): transfer 1 mL of the 18-24 h incubated SCDB' to 10 mL Rappaport Vassiliadis Salmonella broth (RVS), 30-35 °C 18-24 h; subculture on XLD, BGA or HEA agar, 30-35 °C 24-48 h; suspect colonies (red with or without black centres on XLD; small transparent colourless or opaque pink/white on BGA; blue-green with or without black centres on HEA); confirm by Gram stain (gram-negative short rods), TSI slant (alkaline red slant, acid yellow butt, with or without blackening) at 30-35 °C 24-48 h; if possible confirm with an identification system (report if probability above 70%). Limit absent in 10 g.

details.enrichment: SCDB' 18-24 h, then 1 mL to 10 mL RVS, 30-35 °C 18-24 h

openQuestions.question: Length: the spec sheet says '17.7 mm ± 0.3%' and also '(17.4 - 18) mm'. A 0.3% tolerance would be about ±0.05 mm; the bracketed range equals ±0.3 mm. Loaded as 17.4 to 18.0 mm; confirm the tolerance unit.
